title: Transport an invariant primary module chain to etale sheaf short exact sequences
statement: Let $K,K^s,\Omega$ be fields, with $K^s$ a separable closure of $K$ [def-pd-separable-closure] and $\Omega$ an algebraically closed extension containing $K^s$ over $K$. Put $G=\operatorname{Gal}(K^s/K)$ with the Krull topology. Let $M$ be an abelian etale sheaf on $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $R$ a finite discrete continuous integer representation of $G$ [def-exc-discrete-modules-category]. Suppose an additive isomorphism $i:R\simeq M_{\bar s}$ to its geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] identifies the action on $R$ with the action on germs: for each $g\in G$, each extension $\tau\in\operatorname{Aut}_K(\Omega)$ of $g$, and each section $z$ represented at a pointed etale lift $x$, applying $g$ to its image in $R$ corresponds to the same section at $\tau\circ x$. Let $\ell$ be prime, $H\subset G$ open, and $L=(K^s)^H$ finite over $K$. Suppose $A_0\subseteq\cdots\subseteq A_n$ are additive subgroups of $R$, invariant under $H$, with $A_0=0$, $A_n=R$, $\ell A_{a+1}\subseteq A_a$, and $gx-x\in A_a$ for $g\in H$, $x\in A_{a+1}$. For every scheme $T$ and isomorphism $e:\operatorname{Spec}L\simeq T$, there are abelian etale sheaves $F(a)$ on $T$, indexed by $a\in\mathbb N$, with $F(0)=0$, short exact sequences $0\to F(a)\to F(a+1)\to (\underline{\mathbb Z/\ell})^{\oplus d_a}\to0$ for $a<n$ and some $d_a\geq0$ [def-sc-constant-sheaves], and $F(n)\simeq q^{-1}M$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], where $q=e^{-1}\circ\operatorname{Spec}(K\hookrightarrow L)$. No curve, normalization, construction of H, or degree assertion is part of this statement.

proof.text: Obtain the canonical fixed-field comparison C. Construct the restricted representation and each invariant subgroup representation explicitly, with open stabilizers proved by preimage and subtype equality. Define idx(a)=min(a,n) and F(a)=P_C(V_{A(idx(a))}). The bottom subgroup gives a zero representation; fully faithful functors reflect zero objects and inverse image across e preserves them.

For a<n, monotonicity supplies the subtype inclusion A(a)->A(a+1). Its sheaf inclusion and categorical cokernel form the explicit primarySheafSequence. Apply the single-inclusion exactness/quotient comparison using the trivial-action half of hstep. Apply the finite prime-field quotient identification using its annihilation half. Compose these two isomorphisms inline; idx(a)=a and idx(a+1)=a+1 identify the first two terms with F(a) and F(a+1).

At idx(n)=n, the top subgroup inclusion is an isomorphism to the restricted ambient module, constructed using its injectivity and surjectivity. Apply the inverse-image restriction comparison for the given i and haction and compose with the inverse of this top-stage isomorphism after applying the associated-sheaf construction. For n=0 the same formulas work and there are no successor conditions.

theorem exists_sheaf_filtration_of_invariant_primary_chain
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (M : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (R : Rep.DiscreteContinuousRep.{0, u, u + 1} ℤ (Gal(Ks/K)))
    (i : AddCommGrpCat.of R.obj.V ≅
      ((pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M)
    (haction : ∀ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) (τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω)
      (hτ : (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω))
      (X : (Spec (.of K)).Etale)
      (x x' : (pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).fiber.obj X)
      (hx : x'.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom) ≫ x.left)
      (z : M.obj.obj (op X)),
      i.hom (R.obj.ρ g (i.inv ((pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber X x M.obj z))) =
      (pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))).toPresheafFiber
        X x' M.obj z)
    (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) [Finite R.obj.V]
    (H : OpenSubgroup (Gal(Ks/K)))
    [FiniteDimensional K (IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup)]
    (n : ℕ) (A : Fin (n + 1) → AddSubgroup R.obj.V)
    (hmono : Monotone A) (hzero : A 0 = ⊥) (htop : A (Fin.last n) = ⊤)
    (hstable : ∀ (a : Fin (n + 1)) (g : H) (x : R.obj.V),
      x ∈ A a → R.obj.ρ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) x ∈ A a)
    (hstep : ∀ (a : Fin n) (x : R.obj.V), x ∈ A a.succ →
      ℓ • x ∈ A a.castSucc ∧ ∀ g : H, R.obj.ρ (g : Gal(Ks/K)) x - x ∈ A a.castSucc)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (e : Spec (.of (IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup)) ≅ T) :
    ∃ F : ℕ → Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
      IsZero (F 0) ∧
      (∀ a : ℕ, a < n →
        ∃ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (d : ℕ),
          S.ShortExact ∧ Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ F a) ∧ Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ F (a + 1)) ∧
          Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ Nat.rec (0 : _)
            (fun _ B ↦ B ⊞ T.constantZMod ℓ) d)) ∧
      Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (e.inv ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap K (IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup))))).obj M ≅ F n)
